headline: HEMLO HITS 16.1 g/t Au OVER 8.1m in Newly Found South-Rim Zone at Ontario Gold Mine
snippet: Hemlo Mining Corp. (TSXV: HMMC) intersected 16.1 g/t gold over 8.1 metres — including 59.7 g/t over 2m — in a newly identified South-Rim Zone running adjacent to active C-Zone mining at the Hemlo Gold Mine near Marathon, Ontario. All seven initial holes hit the target; geologists now recognize the structure as extending 1.5 km vertically in a plunge-controlled corridor, with five drills turning in a 20-hole follow-up program.

headline: MILEI GREENLIGHTS $1.24B LITHIUM EXPANSION: Argentina's RIGI Approval Unlocks Cauchari-Olaroz Stage 2
snippet: Lithium Argentina received approval under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI) on May 14 for a $1.24 billion Stage 2 expansion of the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation, targeting an additional 45,000 tpa of lithium carbonate equivalent capacity. The RIGI approval locks in 30 years of fiscal, tax, and foreign exchange stability for the Ganfeng-partnered project in Jujuy Province.

headline: ANTIMONY GOLD COMBO: NevGold Hits Critical Mineral in All Drill Holes at Nevada's Limousine Butte
snippet: NevGold Corp. (TSXV: NAU) intercepted consistent oxide antimony-gold mineralization in every drillhole from the historic Crushed leach pad at Limousine Butte, Nevada, highlighted by 0.32% Sb and 0.39 g/t Au over 14.9m. The company holds C$42M in treasury and is advancing toward a maiden MRE, with near-term antimony production potential by 2027 at a project it calls one of the most strategically important critical minerals assets in the US.

headline: SOUTH32 BACKS Nevada CRD Drill: Ridgeline Minerals Kicks Off Partner-Funded Selena Holes
snippet: Ridgeline Minerals Corp. (TSXV: RDG) initiated its 2026 drill program at the Chinchilla Sulfide CRD discovery at the Selena Project in Nevada, with three deep holes targeting sulfide-rich zones identified by borehole EM surveys — all funded by South32, which can earn up to 80% of the project by spending US$20M. The program includes a 250m step-out to the northeast of the 2025 discovery hole and a new skarn target adjacent to the Butte Valley porphyry system.

headline: Golden Goose Resources Maps 23.6km of GOLD-SILVER VEINS in Argentina, Lines Up Inaugural Drill
snippet: Golden Goose Resources completed Phase 1 field mapping at its Gran Esperanza gold-silver project in Río Negro Province, Argentina, defining 23.6 km of vein structures across a 3,950 km² package through systematic geological mapping, structural surveys, and channel sampling. The company is now advancing toward its inaugural drill program with multiple high-priority vein targets outlined.

headline: DISCOVERY SILVER Posts Solid Q1 Cash Flow, Eyes Path to 500,000 oz/Year Gold Output
snippet: Discovery Silver Corp. (TSX: DSV) reported solid Q1 2026 earnings and cash flow from its Porcupine Operations in Ontario, where the company is targeting a path to more than 500,000 ounces of annual gold production — more than double current output. The results were released before market open on May 14, supported by strong realized gold prices and ongoing resource expansion drilling across all Porcupine targets.

headline: URANIUM NEAR $86 as Microsoft, Meta Stack Nuclear Deals for Surging AI Data Centers
snippet: Uranium spot prices held near $86/lb on May 13 as AI hyperscalers including Meta (7.8 GW of contracted nuclear capacity) and Microsoft (800+ MW) continued stacking long-term nuclear power agreements to meet surging data center electricity demand. Kazatomprom's projected 21 million pound supply deficit by 2030 underpins the structural bull case even as spot prices consolidate well below January's $100+ highs.

headline: DOLLAR LOSING ITS GRIP: Money Metals Analyst Says Gold Is Primed to Explode as Reserve Era Ends
snippet: A May 14 Money Metals analysis argues that structural de-dollarization — underscored by Deutsche Bank warnings that the post-Cold War era of US economic supremacy may be ending — builds a gold bull case that is independent of short-term interest rate decisions or inflation prints. The piece contends gold miners carry leveraged upside as the greenback's reserve currency status continues its multi-decade erosion.

headline: GOLDSEEK: Gold's 10-Day Cycle Sets Up Buy — 72-Day Wave Points to Renewed Strength Ahead
snippet: GoldSeek's latest cycle analysis argues that the current gold pullback is a countertrend dip within the upward phase of the larger 72-day cycle, with the short-term 10-day wave bottoming and setting up a return to the 72-day moving average in the days ahead. The analysis treats the current decline as a buying opportunity rather than a reversal, with the key level being how far prices hold during this corrective phase.

headline: SILVER SIGNALS: GoldSilver.com Warns Investors Against Chasing Price — The Structure Is Already in Place
snippet: GoldSilver.com's May 2026 silver outlook argues investors should stop fixating on nominal price levels and recognize that six consecutive supply deficits, nearly 762 million ounces of cumulative drawdowns, and structural industrial demand from solar manufacturing have already built the fundamental case for long-term silver appreciation. The piece warns against reactive trading after big moves like the recent 6% tariff-truce surge, counseling patience over price-chasing.
